method: Re-run the existing manifest profiler on the C02.04 isolated production build. Compare source snapshot, manifest/HTML hashes, every JS/CSS/worker asset hash and sizes, aggregate sizes, and all six route static-import graphs with the C02.04 evidence.
decision: No application source/production-config changes occurred within the measured fingerprint since C02.04; the current artifact, all 221 JS assets, global CSS, mockServiceWorker artifact, totals, and six route graphs match exactly. Therefore no before/after optimization was triggered and none is claimed. RUM remains assigned to B08; the existing per-chunk budget remains an unapproved proposal pending an approved production SLO.
limitations: This revalidation used the existing isolated build output rather than rebuilding because the measured source snapshot and build configuration fingerprint match exactly.
The fingerprint excludes .env files and process environment values; artifact hashes establish the inspected output, not deployed-server settings.
Static manifest graph measurements are not actual network transfer, production RUM, backend/staging, or user acceptance evidence.
